ITEM 1 | Flaky, grey-brown fish-like piece with darker skin edges and pale cream-white flesh, about 6 cm long and 4 cm wide, piled with a moist, slightly glossy white sauce or cream-colored layer on one side, sits on the upper-left of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Creamy white sauce or dressing, glossy and soft, partially draped over the fish piece, about 4 cm across, thin layer, moist sheen | 25
ITEM 3 | Cherry tomatoes, bright red, smooth and glossy skins, whole, about 2.5 cm diameter each, about seven pieces clustered in a group on the left side of the plate | 90
ITEM 4 | Dark reddish-brown small beans or olives, smooth wrinkled skins, matte to slightly shiny, about 1.5 to 2 cm long, about eight pieces in a loose cluster below the tomatoes | 60
ITEM 5 | Finely shredded raw carrot, bright orange, thin matchstick strands about 5 to 7 cm long, moist with slight sheen, loosely heaped on the right side of the plate, covering about a third of the plate | 130
